Roster Editor for Kobe Bryant in NBA Courtside

Posted by: Andrew in Kobe Bryant in NBA Courtside September 6, 2026 0

Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 1:22
Instaread

As you may have seen, wiscard_rush recently released a ROM hack for Kobe Bryant in NBA Courtside for Nintendo 64 that takes the game back to the 1996 season. He’s now released an NBA Courtside roster editor, allowing the community to work on their own ROM hacks for the game.

Once again, it’s very exciting to see these developments with retro basketball gaming and modding. Emulation is seemingly opening up new modding opportunities all the time, and while our community is turning its attention to NBA 2K27, we do have people who enjoy playing and tinkering with old favourites; myself included. Getting a roster editor for Kobe Bryant in NBA Courtside after all these years is also interesting as it allows us to view player ratings, which are infamously hidden for all original players.

Check out the tool at the link below, and shout out to wiscard_rush for all of his efforts developing mods, ROM hacks, and utilities! We definitely appreciate the hard work, and the willingness to freely share it for everyone to enjoy.

wiscard_rush
Kobe Bryant’s Courtside Roster Editor

Thanks to everyone who continues to contribute to our Downloads database! If you need help uploading files, be sure to check out this video tutorial. For more information about downloads, the modding community, and Mod Releases bulletins, please see this FAQ in our Wiki.

NLSC Podcast

NLSC Podcast #646: What Gamers Are Saying About NBA 2K27

NBA 2K27 is out now for everyone, meaning that more gamers have had a chance to get their hands on this year’s release. To that end, this week we join the community in sharing some further impressions of NBA 2K27 – both positive and negative – covering gameplay, modes, and content. We also react to some reviews on Steam that seem rather fishy, as well as a couple that are definitely amusing to read.
